title: YamlDotNet
description: A YAML serializer and parser for .NET, supporting serialization, deserialization, and object traversal.

data.text: YamlDotNet is a .NET library for working with YAML. It supports serializing and deserializing objects to and from YAML, and provides an API for traversing and manipulating YAML documents.

data.title: Serialization and Deserialization

terms.definition: A human-readable data serialization language commonly used for configuration files.
A fluent API for configuring YAML serialization.

data.title: Use Case
data.text: YamlDotNet is commonly used for configuration files (e.g., docker-compose.yml, GitHub Actions).

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use YamlDotNet when you need to read or write YAML files in .NET.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Serialize a configuration object to YAML.
data.expectedOutcome: A YAML file representing the configuration object.
